title: Add and manage an Active Directory data source

source.note: The Figma file gives the flow and content only. The look is the Lepide Design System; never copy Figma's styling.

routes.note: The Active Directory tile shows "N configured" and opens the overview.
With no domain added yet, the wizard opens at once (navigation state { add: true }).

entry.goesTo: overview, or the wizard when no domain is added

screens.title: Added data source for Active Directory
layout: Breadcrumb: Add Data Source / Active Directory
Title with building icon and the count of audited domains
Segmented: one item per domain (picks the domain shown below)
Right: card 'Credentials for <domain>' with the server table, then card 'Profile information' (key/values)

actions.label: Edit
actions.does: Opens the wizard in edit mode for the domain

actions.label: Delete
actions.does: ConfirmDialog 'Delete domain', then removes it; toast 'Domain deleted'. Deleting the last domain returns to the picker.

actions.label: Uninstall agent
actions.disabledWhen: no server has the agent installed
actions.does: ConfirmDialog 'Uninstall agent', then every server's agent becomes Not Installed

actions.label: Upgrade agent
actions.disabledWhen: no server has the agent installed

actions.label: Audit changes from remote system
actions.does: Info toast: not part of the prototype yet

actions.label: Remove remote domain auditing
actions.does: Info toast: not part of the prototype yet

actions.label: Create Active Directory backup
actions.does: Toast 'Active Directory backup started' with the backup path

actions.label: Manage disk
actions.does: Info toast: not part of the prototype yet

wizard.frame: Full-page wizard: 'Back to the list' + breadcrumb 'Active Directory / <title>', eyebrow 'Step N of M · <step>', Steps bar, one white card with the step and a footer.
wizard.footer: Back (left, from step 2) · Cancel · primary Next (→). The last data step's primary is 'Finish' (add) or 'Save' (edit). The Status step shows only 'Done', enabled when the run ends.

express.label: Express configuration
express.description: Configure the domain with default settings.

advanced.label: Advanced configuration
advanced.description: Configure the domain with each setting individually.

modes.edit: Same steps as the domain's mode without 'status'; the mode and the domain name can't change; no Configure auditing dialog; Save writes the changes and returns to the overview with toast 'Active Directory updated'.

wizard.validation: On Next: invalid fields get aria-invalid (red outline) and an error toast 'Check the highlighted fields' with the message below. Fields clear their error as soon as they change.

steps.label: Domain credentials

fields.label: Test connection
fields.does: Needs domain, user and password; success toast 'Connection successful' and the link turns into 'Connection verified'

options.label: Without agent
options.note: An agent for monitoring non-owner mailbox access will still be deployed.

options.label: With agent
options.note: This shared folder should be present on all audited domain controllers and Exchange servers.

errors.missing: Enter the domain name or IP address, user name and password.
errors.user: Enter the user name as "Domain\UserName" or "user@domain".
errors.share: Enter the shared folder, or use the default location.

steps.onNext: Scans the domain's servers, then opens the 'configureAuditing' dialog (add mode only).

steps.label: Domain configuration
steps.lead: Select the component(s) and server(s) to be audited.
tools: Restore to default (components and servers back to default)
Re-scan server list (keeps settings of servers already listed)
steps.settingsButton: Gear IconButton, enabled while the component is ticked. In this prototype it shows an info toast; the Figma file has a sub-flow for each (not built yet).

rules: Change auditing toggles are disabled when their group's component is off (AD group: Audit Active Directory or Audit Exchange Server; GP group: Audit Group Policy).
Health monitoring toggles need the Health Monitoring component; ticking it turns health on for the AD group.
Non-owner mailbox toggles need Non-Owner Mailbox Auditing and exist only for the AD group.
Unticking a component turns its column off on every server.

errors.noComponent: Select at least one component to audit.
errors.noServer: Turn on auditing for at least one server.

steps.label: IP configuration
steps.lead: Review the IP address each server is mapped to. Edit any that are wrong.

fields.label: Preferred DC for general calls and backup
fields.options: the domain controllers of the AD group

steps.note: The IP address is editable. Lepide will not monitor a computer until it is mapped to its correct IP address.

link.label: Configure LDAPS
link.does: Info toast (LDAPS is configured from the domain's settings; Figma has an Edit AD › LDAPS sub-flow)

errors.ip: Enter a valid IPv4 address (for example 192.168.30.21) for each server.

steps.label: Database settings
steps.lead: Enter the SQL Server details used to store the audit data.

fields.label: Test connection
fields.does: Needs the server name; success toast and 'Connection verified'

fields.label: Database
fields.control: Radio 'Create database' + TextField, or radio 'Select database' + SelectField

steps.expressNote: Express configuration: all organizational units and object classes are audited. Change this later by editing the domain.

errors.sqlServer: Enter the SQL Server name or click Browse.
errors.sqlUser: Enter the SQL Server user name and password.
errors.database: Enter a name for the database.

steps.label: Organizational units
steps.lead: Specify the organizational units to be audited.
steps.whenAll: Info banner: every organizational unit in <DOMAIN> is audited; the OU controls are disabled.

dualList.left: OU path list: header checkbox (select all shown), search, a checkbox per path, footer 'N of M record(s)'
dualList.right: Selected OU path (N): 'Clear all' button, each path with a remove (×) IconButton; empty state 'No OU paths selected yet.'

errors.empty: Add at least one organizational unit, or audit all of them.

steps.label: Object classes
steps.lead: Select the object classes and other settings to be audited.

fields.label: Active Directory object classes
fields.control: checkbox list with search and select-all

fields.label: Exchange Server object classes
fields.control: checkbox list with search and select-all

fields.label: Audit successful user logon/logoff
fields.control: Checkbox + gear IconButton (opens 'logonScript', enabled while ticked)

steps.summary: 'Only the selected N class(es)' / 'All except the selected N class(es)' will be audited.

errors.empty: Select at least one object class, or audit all of them.

steps.label: Status
steps.does: The domain is saved when Finish is clicked; this step runs the tasks with a progress bar, then 'Done' opens the overview on the new domain with toast 'Active Directory added'.
tasks: Enabling audit policies through "<GPO>" — or 'Skipping audit policies (set up manually)'
Installing agent on <preferred DC> (only with an agent)
steps.manualWarning: When auditing is set up manually: warning banner 'Auditing isn't enabled on this domain yet. Apply the audit policies manually, then check the change auditing status.'

dialogs.title: Configure auditing
body: To enable auditing automatically, the software deploys an agent on the primary domain controller of <domain>. The agent is removed once the changes for auditing are made. You can also make these changes manually.

Block: 'Auditing isn't enabled for this domain. Lepide Auditor for Active Directory will:' · Enable these system audit policies: System, Logon/Logoff, Object Access, Privilege Use, Detailed Tracking, Policy Change, Account Management, DS Access, Account Logon. · Set up the audit entries as follows: table (Auditing entries for, Naming context, Principal, Access)

options: Yes, the software can make the required changes.
No, I will adjust these settings manually later.

dialogs.title: Group Policy Object selection

fields.label: Create a backup of the selected GPO before enabling auditing

dialogs.footer: Back (to Configure auditing) · Cancel · primary Done

dialogs.title: Create logon/logoff script

fields.label: IP address of the machine running the Logon/Logoff service

dialogs.note: Logon.exe is linked to this IP address and runs only on it.

data.AdConfig: { mode, agent ('none'|'default'|'share'), sharePath, autoAudit, gpo, gpoBackup, components[], servers: AdServer[], preferredDc, sqlServer, sqlAuth, sqlUser, database, dataPath, backupPath, ouScope, ous[], classScope, adClasses[], exClasses[], failedLogon, logonLogoff, added }

data.sampleDirectory: Servers, OU paths and IPs are generated from the domain name in adData.ts (an IP address resolves to LDSP2.COM). Nothing is sent to a server.
